top_choice_rationale: P001 most convincingly combines a fundamental and repeatedly validated mechanistic discovery with a bounded citation and complementary two-person attribution. Confined to foundational unfolded-protein-response and endoplasmic-reticulum signaling discoveries, it recognizes Mori and Walter without extending credit to the wider multi-branch field or later proteostasis and disease work.
recusal_note: No conflict involving the P001 laureates is apparent from the supplied profile. My documented co-authorship and methodological connections concern other researchers and do not establish a connection to Mori or Walter.
